title: nssm variables
description: Configuration variables for NSSM (Non-Sucking Service Manager).

NSSM_VERSION.description: Specific version of nssm to install.

NSSM_INSTALL_DIR.description: Target directory for isolated nssm installation.

NSSM_OFFLINE.description: Flag (true/false or 1/0) indicating air-gapped offline installation mode for nssm.

NSSM_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading nssm release zip archive.
